scope: Original Todoist P0 plus productive widgets for the two independently owned Apple apps. Existing evidence audit reconciled with subsequent native widget acceptance; historical result bundles below are retained, not newly executed.

requirements.requirement: Current API pagination/mapping, useful preview/auth errors, duplicate-free import/retry and unchanged Todoist source.
requirements.boundary: Mac first-import response loss was not separately injected; phone first-import and Mac replay retry are the accepted bounded coverage.

requirements.requirement: Useful capture with supported reference/date/deadline/estimate/repeat/reminder grammar, explicit invalid feedback and durable edits.
requirements.boundary: Full Todoist natural-language equivalence is not claimed; remaining spoken coverage is separate.

requirements.requirement: Stable account-owned filters/favorites/view settings; original documented Boolean/date/target subset, offline persistence, safe ordering and access boundaries.
requirements.boundary: All-four-table SQL evidence, shared owned ORDER implementation and representative native conflict/handoffs cover the bounded contract. Per-list native permutations remain unexercised, not universally accepted.

requirements.requirement: Independent deadline/estimate, rescheduling/Undo, recurrence boundaries, old-cache/backup compatibility and honest hourly/calendar capacity.
requirements.boundary: Read-only EventKit is implemented; external mirroring and richer recurrence grammar retain their original later-phase scope.

requirements.requirement: Local scheduling, actual closed-app actions/snooze, cancellation and account/stale-callback safety.
requirements.boundary: Simulator/local alerts do not prove APNs or signed distribution.

requirements.requirement: Validated portable/encrypted restore, relationships, safe Cancel/retry, account-owned reads and actual external-provider boundaries.
requirements.boundary: Actual iOS provider download/offline failure/late callback remains unaccepted; local held reads and Mac cloud transfer do not replace it.

requirements.requirement: Relevant work survives device switches, offline queues/review, generation/identity guards and access revocation.
requirements.boundary: Old active writers must be upgraded/retired; service still allows legacy direct writes. Nested/attachment collision evidence is core/transport, not a claimed universal native matrix.

requirements.requirement: Twelve productive kinds, stable per-instance configuration, useful routes/actions, durable completion, privacy/account isolation and readable installed hosts.
requirements.boundary: Installed Mac My list automatic expiry/persisted completion and current-source configured-project cold task route accepted. Configured Pinned note cold open/edit/preview refresh/edited-note cold reopen accepted. Installed Focus paused-session cold route and subsequent native Resume/Pause/End accepted with only session data changed; ended preview confirmed and exact ended cold-launch state inspected, with inferred click attribution. Project pulse installed cold route/forward completion refresh accepted; native Undo restores task/totals and installed reverse refresh accepted. Four named installed kinds clear/recover on normal-local leave/return; signed-out Pulse cold route opens sign-in safely. Cloud-account-to-account transitions remain separate. Remaining distinct Mac configuration/action/account/empty classes and actual system-selected redaction/routing stay open; previews and native URL-handler tests do not substitute.

requirements.requirement: Native capture/edit/plan/complete/Undo/recovery, accessible controls and explicit assessment of actual runtime findings.
requirements.boundary: Remaining genuine spoken critical-control coverage. Named renderer cycles are fixed; scoped table/QoS framework findings remain risks. No blanket clean-runtime or every-control speech claim.

requirements.requirement: Independent app/release sources, compatible candidate pair, real provider/device delivery and signed distribution before rollout.
requirements.boundary: Enrolled signing/capabilities, final provider/device/APNs acceptance, notarized/signed install and old-writer rollout remain. Remote delivery stays disabled; recognized email is optional future provider work, not active delivery.

verificationBoundary: Ten existing native cases in eight bundles reverified, not ten new executions or proof of every feature. Historical failed/warning-bearing results and artifact limitations remain intact.
remainingPrerequisites: Actual supported system privacy controls/locked transition.
Human spoken-output observations for remaining critical controls.
Configured iOS external file provider for real download/offline/late-callback boundaries.
stoppingRule: Do not invent a gate for every possible combination or substitute easier previews/core tests. Continue distinct actionable risks; resume prerequisite-limited gates when their external state changes.
